name: Rustcog Downs
core_rationale: Western arrival plateau of Continent 02 where Krono's brass gear-ribs emerge from copper grasslands around the Pinion Terminus root-train station.
local_conflict: Wind-pirates and rogue clockwork hounds are stripping copper teeth from the active wind-mills.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Inverted gravity eddies from the Astrolabe Gate tear at copper gliders; the Tinker Guild has chained the northern bridge until the Star-Pendulum key is recovered.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Couriers say the brass canyons shift their alignment every full moon when the buried mainspring slips a tooth.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Rolling copper prairies pierced by hundred-meter oxidized brass gear arches.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where does the northern Astrolabe Rift bridge lead once the gravity eddies subside?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits scar-brass-faultline and receives the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct and root-train from Continent 01 at Pinion Terminus.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Hundred-meter brass gear arches rising over wind-swept copper prairies with ticking pendulum shafts.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 14.0 meter wide Titan gear-tooth ramps, 0.15 meter cog-steps, and <= 0.25 meter copper grass for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Orthogonal 2x2 grid with Pinion Terminus [0,1], Brass Spur Ridge [1,1], Pendulum Shaft Dungeon [0,1, floor -1], and Astrolabe Rift [1,0] (Fog of Lore) plus Level 20 to 28 construct/insect spawns.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Astrolabe Rift frontier with a fog_of_lore portal and Tinker Guild gravity-eddy warning.
